_about: Public-domain Charles de Montalembert (1810-1870), French Catholic historian and statesman, in English translation for the Word Hoard: The Monks of the West from St. Benedict to St. Bernard, the authorised translation in seven volumes (1861-1879), the Life of Saint Elizabeth of Hungary tr. Mary Hackett (Dublin, 1848) and Saint Columba, Apostle of Caledonia (1868), from Internet Archive scans. His memoir of Lacordaire is already on the henri-lacordaire shelf. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
